prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent painted stat emblem for an ornate Mexican Loteria-inspired fantasy trading card. Create ONE small, exceptionally clear game UI badge on a genuinely transparent background. Style: hand-painted gilded enamel, crisp dark brown outlines, broad beveled antique-gold edges with warm yellow highlights and restrained brush texture, deep midnight-blue enamel center. Slight dimensional relief but exactly front-facing, symmetric, no perspective. Compact horizontal proportions, approximately 1.9:1 overall silhouette, centered with only 5% clear margins. Center shape occupies about 46% of overall width and 70% of overall height. Two short gold wings, one on each side, each composed of just three broad streamlined feather tiers, stretch horizontally and modestly upward behind the center. A small thin elliptical gold halo floats just above the center, with clear transparent separation; no rays. The middle blue enamel must be completely EMPTY and dark enough to later receive a large cream two-digit number and a small cream CRED label as real HTML. Absolutely NO text, NO numbers, NO letters, NO symbols inside the blue area. No ribbon, no banner, no ribbon tails, no laurel, no rosette, no flowers, no gems, no holographic shine, no extra ornaments, no background plate, no drop shadow outside the silhouette. Preserve generous uncluttered central number space. Make the gold warm and luminous like traditional illustrated trading-card coin borders, not photorealistic metal. This badge will display only 175 pixels wide; prioritize bold shapes over fine detail. Center shape: a smooth upright oval cartouche with a substantial beveled gold rim and a clean uninterrupted oval midnight-blue interior. The oval is gently taller than it is wide. No heart motif anywhere.

Use case: precise-object-edit. The attached image is the edit target, a painted gold-and-blue game-card emblem. Replace ONLY the two feathered wings with a much more compact GEOMETRIC stepped wing treatment. Each new wing consists of exactly THREE short straight horizontal gold bars / tapered trapezoid plates stacked with clear transparent gaps, the top bar longest, middle shorter, bottom shortest. Three clean bold tiers, like a restrained Art Deco insignia. Straight upper edges, subtly chamfered outer corners, modest beveled gold shading; NO feather texture, NO curves or sweeping tips, NO anatomical wing shapes, NO extra plates or flourishes. Each wing projects only about one third of the width of the central oval beyond its side, making the whole badge much more compact than the current wings. The three tiers sit alongside the middle section of the oval, well below the halo, no wings near the top edge. Preserve the central oval EXACTLY in shape, dark blue enamel color, blank interior, and substantial gold rim. Preserve the small floating gold halo. Retain the same warm painted gold palette, crisp dark edges and illustrated game art quality. Center the finished compact emblem on a closely fitted transparent canvas with about 5% empty margin around its silhouette. No lettering or numerals anywhere. No ribbons or banner. Genuine transparent background, preserve alpha.
